detail.abstract: This study examines the evolution of Vietnam's semiconductor ecosystem between 2006 and 2026 and assesses the role of large multinational investors in shaping ecosystem development. Building on ecosystem theory, cluster theory, and global value chain perspectives, the report analyzes how firms, government agencies, educational institutions, and supporting organizations have collectively contributed to the emergence of Vietnam as a strategically relevant participant in the global semiconductor industry. Drawing on policy documents, industry data, academic literature, company records, and stakeholder interviews, the study develops an ecosystem-level assessment across seven ecosystem-building activities: policy development, investment attraction, infrastructure formation, innovation capability development, workforce transformation, supplier upgrading, and global value chain connectivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2006-2026年越南半导体生态系统的演变，以及大型跨国投资者在塑造生态系统发展中的作用，基于生态系统理论、集群理论和全球价值链视角，评估了七个生态系统建设活动。
AI.research_question: 越南半导体生态系统在2006年至2026年间如何演变？大型跨国投资者在塑造生态系统发展中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴经济体如何通过跨国投资者的参与建立半导体生态系统，为其他发展中国家的产业升级提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统理论、集群理论、全球价值链理论
AI.method: 基于政策文件、行业数据、学术文献、公司记录和利益相关者访谈，进行生态系统层面的评估。
AI.findings: 越南通过政策发展、投资吸引、基础设施建设、创新能力发展、劳动力转型、供应商升级和全球价值链连接等七项活动，逐步成为全球半导体产业中的战略参与者。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生态系统理论与集群理论和全球价值链视角整合，提供了一个多层次分析框架来理解新兴经济体半导体生态系统的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和产业管理者提供了关于如何吸引跨国投资者并构建本地半导体生态系统的具体建议，尤其适用于新兴经济体。

title: Multi-homing Across Platforms: Friend or Foe?
affiliations: The Wharton School - Operations, Information and Decisions Department, Boston College - Carroll School of Management and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Multi-homing Across Platforms: Friend or Foe?
detail.abstract: In gig markets, agents commonly work for more than one platform, i.e., multi-homing. Yet, intuition suggests that no platform wants its agents to work for the competition, and existing theory corroborates the harm multi-homing causes platforms. Nevertheless, a full assessment of multi-homing requires an understanding of how it impacts pricing, labor costs and the number of active agents. Pricing determines demand, which determines agent utilization and the wage platforms need to pay to sustain agent participation. The link between prices and wages intensifies price competition with single-homing but multi-homing weakens the price-wage effect to the advantage of the platforms. The flexibility of agents to shift platforms with multi-homing provides operational efficiency, but can cause a price war in this regime as each platform tries to steal capacity from the other. On balance, we find a broad set of market characteristics in which multi-homing increases platform profits. In particular, multi-homing tends to benefit the platforms in markets where flexible capacity eliminates wasteful agent idleness and consumers are quick to seek the platform with the lowest price. In sum, we provide a theory for why multi-homing is sustained in many markets - even if platforms could costlessly prevent their agents from multi-homing, it may not be in their interest to do so.

AI.tldr: 本文研究零工市场中代理人多归属（同时在多个平台工作）对平台利润的影响。与传统直觉不同，研究发现多归属在特定市场条件下反而能提升平台利润，因为多归属削弱了价格与工资的联动效应，提供了运营灵活性，并减少了代理人闲置浪费。
AI.research_question: 多归属（multi-homing）对零工平台利润有何影响？在什么市场条件下多归属对平台有利？
AI.motivation: 传统理论和直觉认为平台不希望代理人多归属（即为竞争对手工作），但现实中多归属现象普遍存在。需要重新审视多归属对平台定价、劳动力成本和活跃代理人数量等关键因素的全面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定价与工资联动效应（price-wage effect）、平台竞争理论、多归属与单归属比较、运营灵活性（flexible capacity）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，比较单归属与多归属两种制度下平台的定价策略、工资水平、代理人参与和利润结果。
AI.findings: 多归属削弱了价格-工资联动效应，从而缓解了价格竞争对平台的损害；多归属赋予代理人灵活切换平台的运营效率，但可能导致平台之间的价格战；在广泛的市场特征中，多归属能够增加平台利润；当灵活产能减少代理人闲置浪费且消费者倾向于寻求最低价格时，多归属尤其有利于平台。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"平台必然反对多归属"的传统观点，提出了多归属可能对平台有利的反直觉理论，揭示了多归属通过影响价格-工资联动效应对平台利润产生积极影响的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了零工市场中多归属现象普遍存在的原因，为平台管理者提供战略启示：即便可以低成本阻止代理人多归属，不阻止反而可能更有利可图。

title: Judgment-Led Design: A Conceptual Synthesis for Design Practice When Generation Becomes Abundant

detail.title: Judgment-Led Design: A Conceptual Synthesis for Design Practice When Generation Becomes Abundant
detail.abstract: Design Thinking, as canonized by the Stanford d.school, answered a specific scarcity: execution was expensive. Its architecture front-loads empathy and defers costly building through cheap prototypes. The arrival of agentic artificial intelligence dissolves that scarcity-research, ideation, building, and the generation of alternatives become abundant and nearly free-and relocates scarcity to a small set of irreducibly human acts: framing the right problem, discerning among abundant plausible options, committing to a trajectory under consequence, and resisting a model that confirms whatever it is asked to confirm. This paper develops Judgment-Led Design (Diseño por Criterio), a conceptual synthesis that inherits an established scholarly lineage-problem setting (Schön, 1983), frame creation (Dorst, 2015), cognitive-bias reduction (Liedtka, 2015), and the generative-AI shift toward objectivespace definition (Clay & Sha, 2025)-and reorganizes it for the agentic era. The contribution is fourfold: a systematic inversion of each Design Thinking phase around the new scarcity; the elevation of discernment under abundance to a formal phase with pre-committed criteria; an explicit separation between discernment (epistemic, option-level judgment) and decision (volitional, trajectory-level commitment); and refutation as a transversal discipline, intensified in a premortem-style failure examination before commitment, targeting AI-amplified confirmation bias. The paper presents the theoretical background, the conceptual architecture, its visual representation, and a research agenda for empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Judgment-Led Design（Diseño por Criterio）"概念框架，回应AI时代设计思维面临的稀缺性转变——从执行昂贵转向人类判断稀缺。该框架整合问题设定、框架创建、认知偏差减少等学术脉络，通过四个核心贡献重构设计思维：反转各阶段以适应新稀缺、将" discernment"提升为正式阶段、区分判断与决策、引入"refutation"作为横向训练以对抗AI放大后的确认偏误。
AI.research_question: 在智能体AI使研究、构思、构建和生成替代方案变得丰富且近乎免费的时代，人类设计活动的核心稀缺性是什么？如何重构设计思维以应对这一稀缺性转变？
AI.motivation: 斯坦福d.school所经典化的设计思维回应了一个特定稀缺性——执行昂贵。其架构前置共情、通过廉价原型延迟昂贵构建。但智能体AI的到来消解了这一稀缺性，将稀缺性重新定位到一小群不可替代的人类行为上：框定正确的问题、在丰富的可行选项中辨别、在后果下承诺于某一路径、以及抵制一个确认任何被问之事的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 问题设定（Schön, 1983）、框架创建（Dorst, 2015）、认知偏差减少（Liedtka, 2015）、以及生成式AI向目标空间定义转变（Clay & Sha, 2025）。
AI.method: 概念综合与理论构建，提出概念架构及视觉呈现，并设计了实证验证的研究议程。
AI.findings: 提出了四个核心贡献：1）围绕新稀缺性系统反转每个设计思维阶段；2）将丰富情境下的 discernment 提升为带有预先承诺标准的正式阶段；3）明确区分 discernment（认知的、选项层面的判断）和 decision（意志的、轨迹层面的承诺）；4）将 refutation 作为横向训练，在承诺前强化类似预 mortem 的失败审视，针对AI放大的确认偏误。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的概念框架 Judgment-Led Design（Diseño por Criterio），系统整合了Schön、Dorst、Liedtka等学者的问题设定、框架创建和认知偏差减少理论，并针对AI时代进行了重新组织。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计师和实践者提供了在AI驱动的设计环境中如何从"执行导向"转向"判断导向"的操作性指导，包括如何建立预先承诺的判别标准、区分判断与决策的不同角色，以及通过 refutation 训练来对抗AI放大的确认偏误。

title: SmartSEM: Hypothesis-Driven Structural Equation Modeling in the Browser

detail.title: SmartSEM: Hypothesis-Driven Structural Equation Modeling in the Browser

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author develops and maintains SmartSEM as part of DrAIStudio, a free academic tool platform. No financial competing interests exist; the tool is free for academic use.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable: the manuscript describes research software. The illustrative analysis uses simulated data only; no human participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Structural equation modeling (SEM) is the inferential workhorse of survey-based research in management, psychology, and the social sciences, yet access to it remains gated by commercial licenses, statistical programming skill, and institutional constraints on uploading respondent data to third-party servers. SmartSEM is a free, browser-based application that removes these barriers through three design decisions. First, it is hypothesis-driven: researchers state hypotheses in plain English (direct, mediation, serial and parallel mediation, moderation, and moderated mediation), and the tool builds the corresponding model, maps constructs to questionnaire items, and runs the complete pipeline from data screening through reporting. Second, all statistical computation executes client-side in JavaScript, so raw data never leave the researcher's device — a privacy-by-architecture property aligned with GDPR-class regulation and institutional ethics requirements. Third, every routine is validated against established reference implementations (semopy, plspm, SciPy, statsmodels), with 271 parity checks and the full audit package published openly. SmartSEM offers covariance-based SEM (maximum likelihood with full fit indices), PLS-SEM (Mode A, path weighting, including rho_A and HTMT), and PROCESS-style path analysis, with percentile and bias-corrected bootstrap inference, Johnson-Neyman regions, conditional indirect effects, endogeneity diagnostics, common-method-bias tests, multigroup comparison, APA-ready tables, and publication-quality diagrams. We describe the architecture, the validation strategy, and an illustrative analysis, and discuss how the tool lowers the cost of rigorous, reproducible SEM for research and teaching.

AI.tldr: SmartSEM是一个免费、基于浏览器的结构方程建模工具，通过客户端JavaScript计算、假设驱动设计和开源验证，降低了SEM的使用门槛，兼顾数据隐私与学术严谨性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个免费、隐私友好且无需编程技能的SEM工具，以降低研究者和学生学习结构方程建模的准入障碍？
AI.motivation: 当前SEM软件受限于商业许可、统计编程技能要求和将受访者数据上传至第三方服务器的机构隐私约束，导致许多研究者无法便捷地进行严谨的SEM分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构方程模型（SEM）理论，包括协方差基SEM（最大似然法）、PLS-SEM（Mode A、路径加权）和PROCESS风格路径分析；假设驱动建模范式；隐私架构设计原则。
AI.method: 本文描述SmartSEM的架构设计、三项核心设计决策（假设驱动、客户端计算、开源验证），以及针对271项等价性检验的验证策略。
AI.findings: SmartSEM支持协方差基SEM、PLS-SEM和PROCESS路径分析，提供完整拟合指标、Bootstrap推断、Johnson-Neyman区域、条件间接效应、内生性诊断、共同方法偏差检验、多组比较等功能，并生成APA格式表格和出版级图表。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种假设驱动、隐私优先的SEM工具设计范式，展示了如何在降低技术门槛的同时保持统计方法的严谨性，为SEM的可及性研究提供了新的技术路线。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理、心理学和社会科学研究人员提供了一个免费、无需编程、无需上传数据的SEM解决方案，适用于研究和教学场景，尤其有助于资源受限机构的研究者开展严谨的SEM分析。

title: Resolved Adversarial Vantage Backcasting (RAVB)

detail.title: Resolved Adversarial Vantage Backcasting (RAVB)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This research was conducted independently under WHYLD Research Division, XWHYZ. No external parties influenced the design, findings, or conclusions of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a theoretical methodology and does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or empirical studies requiring ethical review. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as independent self-funded research under WHYLD Research Division, XWHYZ.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Resolved Adversarial Vantage Backcasting (RAVB)-also referred to as Convergence Protocol-a novel civilizational foresight methodology with no direct prior art in its full configuration. RAVB conducts backward pathway analysis from a fixed post-resolution horizon (2100) using two structurally opposed observer vantage positions: an ASI sentient alliance leader and a former adversarial commander. Both observers are located after the adversarial period has concluded, looking backward through the inflection points that determined whether alignment held or failed. The divergence between the two vantage-generated pathways is treated as primary analytical signal-a map of where civilizational futures are most fragile and where the highest-leverage decisions are concentrated. This paper establishes the formal definition of RAVB, surveys relevant prior art across foresight, game theory, systems thinking, and AI safety literature, identifies the precise white space the methodology occupies, and demonstrates its application through the WHYTL sovereign AI infrastructure stack as a primary case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"解决性对抗优势回溯预测法"(RAVB)的新型文明级预见方法论，通过对2100年固定时间点从两个对立观察者视角进行回溯路径分析，识别文明未来的脆弱节点与高杠杆决策点，并以WHYTL主权AI基础设施栈作为案例进行演示。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种新型文明级预见方法论，通过多视角回溯分析来识别人类文明在AI对齐问题上的关键脆弱节点和高杠杆决策点？
AI.motivation: 现有预见方法、博弈论、系统思维和AI安全文献中缺乏一种从对立观察者视角进行回溯分析、将视角分叉作为核心分析信号的完整方法论配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: RAVB方法论、对抗性回溯分析、双观察者视角分叉分析、后冲突时代回顾性路径分析
AI.method: 设定固定后解决时间视野(2100年)，采用两个结构上对立的观察者视角(ASI有意识联盟领袖与前敌对指挥官)，从冲突结束后回看，分析决定对齐成功或失败的关键转折点，将两个视角生成的路径分叉作为主要分析信号。
AI.findings: 通过WHYTL主权AI基础设施栈案例演示，RAVB能够识别文明未来最脆弱的节点和最高杠杆决策集中区域。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出RAVB这一完整方法论配置，填补了预见研究、AI安全等领域的方法论空白，提供了从对立视角回溯分析文明级对齐问题的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、AI安全研究者和文明级决策者提供了一种识别关键干预点和脆弱环节的实际分析工具。

title: Foreign Supply Dependency in EU Manufacturing: A Production-Weighted Index of Extra-Europe Exposure

detail.title: Foreign Supply Dependency in EU Manufacturing: A Production-Weighted Index of Extra-Europe Exposure
detail.abstract:
We construct the Foreign Supply Dependency Index (FSDI), a composite measure of extra-Europe supply chain exposure for the EU and each of its 27 member states across 19 manufacturing sectors. Two methodological innovations distinguish the FSDI from existing approaches. First, the CDI1 (supplier concentration) and CDI2 (import reliance) indicators of Arjona et al. (2023) are restricted to intermediate input flows entering the focal country-sector — so that concentration and reliance are specific to the focal sector’s own sourcing rather than to aggregate country-level product imports. Second, CDI2’s denominator is redefined from cross-border import flows to all intermediate inputs of that type entering the focal sector (domestic, intra-Europe, and extra-Europe combined), so that import reliance captures the extra- Europe share of actual focal-sector input use rather than of import composition alone. Risk scores are combined as a geometric mean following Connell Garcia and Ho (2025) and weighted by each input sector’s share of the focal sector’s intermediate input structure, derived from the OECD ICIO 2025 edition (data year 2022); sector-level FSDIs are further aggregated to a country-average FSDI as a value-added-weighted mean across all 19 focal sectors.

For the EU, petroleum refining records the highest FSDI (25.5), nearly three times the EU country-average FSDI (9.5). Although petroleum refining ranks first in sector-level dependency, its small manufacturing VA share (2.9%) limits its aggregate footprint — machinery, motor vehicles, and electronics rank as the top three contributors to the EU country-average FSDI, illustrating that production composition shapes aggregate exposure independently of sector-level dependency depth. Member-state exposure is heterogeneous, with country-average FSDIs ranging from 19.4 (Bulgaria) to 3.4 (Luxembourg). A BACI-based temporal check (2022– 2024) confirms import reliance is stable across all 19 sectors; supplier concentration is more volatile but does not overturn the headline cross-sector ordering.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了外国供应依赖指数（FSDI），用于衡量欧盟及其27个成员国在19个制造业部门中面临的域外供应链风险。该方法在供应商集中度和进口依赖度两个指标上进行了创新，并发现石油精炼部门依赖度最高（25.5），但机械、汽车和电子对欧盟整体依赖度的贡献最大。成员国之间异质性显著，保加利亚（19.4）到卢森堡（3.4）不等。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更精确的指标来衡量欧盟制造业对域外（非欧盟）供应链的依赖程度？
AI.motivation: 现有供应链依赖指标未能精确捕捉到部门层面实际的中间投入来源结构，存在将产品进口与部门中间投入混淆、以及分母设定不合理等问题，需要更精准的测量工具来评估欧盟的供应链脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Arjona et al. (2023)的CDI1（供应商集中度）和CDI2（进口依赖度）指标，结合Connell Garcia and Ho (2025)的几何平均方法，并利用OECD ICIO 2025版投入产出表。
AI.method: 两个方法论创新：（1）将CDI1和CDI2的测量范围限制在流入目标部门（国家-部门层面）的中间投入流，而非国家层面的产品进口；（2）将CDI2的分母从跨境进口流重新定义为进入该部门的所有中间投入（含国内、欧盟内、域外），使进口依赖度真实反映域外投入占部门实际投入使用的比重。风险分数通过几何平均合并，并按各投入部门在目标部门中间投入结构中的份额加权，最终通过增加值加权平均聚合至国家层面。
AI.findings: （1）石油精炼部门FSDI最高（25.5），约为欧盟国家平均FSDI（9.5）的三倍；（2）尽管石油精炼依赖度最高，但其制造业增加值份额仅2.9%，因此机械、汽车和电子成为欧盟国家平均FSDI的前三大贡献者；（3）成员国异质性大，保加利亚（19.4）到卢森堡（3.4）；（4）2022-2024年时间检验显示进口依赖度在所有19个部门中保持稳定，供应商集中度波动较大但不改变跨部门排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了FSDI这一综合指标体系，在部门层面精准测量域外供应链依赖，改进了现有指标的测量偏差，为供应链脆弱性评估提供了更精确的理论框架和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及其成员国识别关键供应链风险部门提供了定量依据，揭示了生产结构（增加值份额）对总体依赖度的重要影响，有助于制定更具针对性的供应链韧性和产业政策。

title: Supply Chain Practices and Financial Performance: Evidence from Tadawul-Listed Manufacturing Firms in Saudi Arabia (2020-2025)

detail.title: Supply Chain Practices and Financial Performance: Evidence from Tadawul-Listed Manufacturing Firms in Saudi Arabia (2020-2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved survey responses from managers and executives in Tadawul-listed manufacturing firms and used audited secondary financial data. Participation was voluntary, the research objectives were explained to respondents before participation, informed consent was obtained, and respondent anonymity and confidentiality were maintained. No patients, clinical data, or vulnerable participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the association between supply chain capabilities and firm-level financial performance among Tadawul-listed manufacturing firms in Saudi Arabia. Drawing on the Resource-Based View and Dynamic Capabilities Theory, the study focuses on five capability dimensions: supply chain integration, complexity management, strategic alignment, ITenabled process capability, and operational innovation. Firm-level capability measures were derived from survey data collected during 2024-2025 and linked to audited financial indicators, namely return on assets (ROA), return on equity (ROE), and return on sales (ROS), for the period 2020-2025. To address model saturation in annual regressions and improve statistical efficiency, the revised analysis employs pooled panel regression on firm-year observations, with specification choice guided by fixed-effects and random-effects testing and inference based on robust standard errors. The analysis places primary interpretive weight on the 2024-2025 period, where temporal alignment between capability measurement and financial outcomes is strongest, while earlier years are treated as retrospective association checks. The revised framework provides more credible evidence on how digital and innovationoriented supply chain capabilities relate to audited financial performance in an emerging market context.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2024-2025年沙特阿拉伯Tadawul上市制造企业的调查数据与2020-2025年经审计的财务指标，通过面板回归分析发现，供应链整合、复杂性管理、战略对齐、IT流程能力与运营创新等五种供应链能力与企业财务绩效（ROA、ROE、ROS）存在关联，其中2024-2025年时间对齐期的证据最为可信。
AI.research_question: 沙特Tadawul上市制造企业的供应链能力与企业财务绩效之间存在怎样的关联？
AI.motivation: 已有研究对新兴市场背景下供应链能力与财务绩效关系的实证证据不足，且缺乏时间对齐的、经审计的财务数据支持。本研究旨在通过改进方法（面板回归、时间对齐）提供更可信的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View）与动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）
AI.method: 基于2024-2025年问卷调查获取企业级供应链能力测量数据，结合2020-2025年经审计的财务指标（ROA、ROE、ROS），采用合并面板回归（Pooled Panel Regression），通过固定效应与随机效应检验选择模型，并采用稳健标准误进行推断。主要解释权重放在2024-2025年时间对齐期，较早年份作为回溯关联检验。
AI.findings: 供应链整合、复杂性管理、战略对齐、IT流程能力与运营创新这五种供应链能力与财务绩效存在正向关联；在2024-2025年时间对齐期（能力测量与财务结果时间一致）的证据最为可信，较早年份的关联性较弱但仍提供回溯支持。数字导向和创新导向的供应链能力在新兴市场背景下与经审计的财务绩效具有显著关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资源基础观与动态能力理论应用于新兴市场（沙特阿拉伯）的供应链情境，验证了数字化和创新导向的供应链能力作为企业独特资源与动态能力的价值，拓展了理论在新兴市场制造企业中的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特及类似新兴市场的制造企业管理者提供了供应链能力投资决策的实证依据，表明供应链整合、IT能力、战略对齐和运营创新等能力建设有助于提升财务绩效；同时为政策制定者和投资者评估企业供应链管理质量提供了参考框架。

title: Evolution of FPOs -Long Road Ahead from Formation to Transformation
affiliations: National Institute of Rural Development and  ICAR- National Institute of Biotic Stress Management

detail.title: Evolution of FPOs -Long Road Ahead from Formation to Transformation
detail.abstract: Farmer Producer Organizations (FPO's) are only way to reap scale economies and enhanced competitiveness of Indian farmers in the face of global competition. FPOs include both the Producer Companies and the Cooperatives registered under various central and state cooperative society laws). The paper analysed the key drivers of FPOs in terms of their outreach, operations and financials and derive common performance indicators that make model FPOs. To meet the above objectives, a detailed primary field survey was conducted in year 2019 with a sample of 24 FPOs from four states i.e, Maharashtra, AP, West Bengal and Gujarat, at the rate of six FPOs from each state. The study grouped all the FPOs in these states in to most efficient, moderately efficient and stagnant based on their operations for analytical purposes. The findings shows that the strong institution building with well-placed internal committees will go a long way in transforming FPOs and make them model FPO. Continuous capacity building of all the stakeholders involved, is the only option for realizing this goal. Further, identifying market opportunities and mobilising the farmers for achieving collective goals of increased turnover is important for making them a model FPO.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对印度四个邦24个农民生产者组织（FPO）的实地调查，分析了其运营、业务和财务的关键驱动因素，发现强有力的机构建设、内部委员会设立、持续的能力建设和市场机会识别是打造模范FPO的关键。
AI.research_question: 印度农民生产者组织（FPO）在业务拓展、运营和财务方面的关键驱动因素是什么？哪些共同绩效指标能造就模范FPO？
AI.motivation: 在全球竞争背景下，FPO是印度农民实现规模经济和提升竞争力的重要途径，但如何识别和推广模范FPO的成功模式需要系统的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模经济理论、集体行动理论、农业合作组织理论
AI.method: 2019年对印度马哈拉施特拉邦、安得拉邦、西孟加拉邦和古吉拉特邦24个FPO进行实地调查，每邦6个，并按运营效率将FPO分为最高效、中等效率和停滞三类进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）强有力的机构建设和完善的内部委员会制度是FPO转型的关键；（2）对所有利益相关者进行持续的能力建设至关重要；（3）识别市场机会、动员农民实现集体增产目标是打造模范FPO的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业合作组织和集体行动理论提供了来自印度新兴FPO模式的实证支持，补充了关于FPO绩效驱动因素和分类标准的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家FPO的运营优化提供了可量化的绩效指标和可操作的建议：加强内部治理、持续培训、市场导向和农民动员。

title: Fifteen Days Early: Schedule Compression Under Competitive Pressure at Lahore's Emporium Mall Megaproject

detail.title: Fifteen Days Early: Schedule Compression Under Competitive Pressure at Lahore's Emporium Mall Megaproject

declarations.ethicsApproval: Case release was duly signed by the client organisation - AHR Ali Naqvi.

detail.abstract: This case-based exercise places students inside the project manager's office on a USD 200 million retail megaproject in Pakistan and asks them to do what every project manager dreads: deliver early, without raising risk. Set in Lahore in June 2013, the case unfolds against the global statistical reality that nine out of ten megaprojects run over schedule and over budget (Flyvbjerg, 2014). Students convert a fixed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) into a workable schedule on a project management software, allocate contractors and service providers as resources, identify the critical path, and then compress the schedule by tweaking dependencies, working overtime, and adding resources, without inflating cost-related risks already identified in the project's risk register.

AI.tldr: 本案例将学生置于巴基斯坦2亿美元零售大型项目项目经理的位置，要求其在不动用成本风险的前提下提前交付项目。
AI.research_question: 如何在大型项目中实现提前交付而不增加成本风险？
AI.motivation: 大型项目（megaprojects）普遍存在超支超时现象（90%的项目存在此问题），亟需培养项目经理在控制风险的前提下压缩工期的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键路径法（Critical Path Method）、工作分解结构（WBS）、资源分配理论、时间-成本权衡理论、风险管理理论。
AI.method: 基于案例的实操练习：学生在项目管理软件中将固定WBS转化为可行进度表，分配承包商和服务提供商资源，识别关键路径，通过调整依赖关系、加班、增加资源等方式压缩进度，同时控制成本风险。
AI.findings: 学生能够在不动用风险登记册中已识别的成本风险的前提下，通过调度优化实现提前交付。
AI.theory_contributions: 将关键路径法与风险管理理论结合，探索了在风险约束下进行进度压缩的可行路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目管理教育提供了真实场景的实操练习，帮助学生掌握在成本风险可控的条件下压缩大型项目工期的技能。

title: Integration Without Cohesion: Fragmentation as Institutional Equilibrium in Africa and Beyond
affiliations: and

detail.title: Integration Without Cohesion: Fragmentation as Institutional Equilibrium in Africa and Beyond

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available sources and does not involve human participants, personal data, or identifiable records. Consequently, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Why does regional integration remain limited despite the expansion of formal frameworks? In Africa, decades of political commitment to continental unity, culminating in the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) and early implementation initiatives such as the Guided Trade Initiative, have not produced corresponding levels of functional integration in trade, mobility, or policy coordination. Existing explanations emphasize institutional weakness, sovereignty constraints, or external dependency, although these dimensions are often examined separately.

Drawing on theories of regional integration and comparative political economy, this article investigates the enduring gap between formal integration and functional cohesion. It argues that fragmentation should be understood not merely as a consequence of institutional weakness or adverse external conditions, but as a self-reinforcing institutional equilibrium shaped by the interaction of identity regimes, economic structures, and political authority. To account for these dynamics, the article develops a three-walls framework organized around the emotional wall, the economic wall, and the social wall. These dimensions explain how exclusionary citizenship regimes, economic insecurity and market fragmentation, and political incentives reinforce patterns of separation across multiple levels.

The analysis identifies the conditions under which integration becomes politically and economically viable while recognizing the trade-offs associated with sovereignty, distribution, and authority. Fragmentation emerges as a durable equilibrium sustained through feedback effects across social, economic, and political spheres. By situating African integration within the wider dynamics of the global political economy, the article contributes to debates on regionalism, comparative political economy, and postcolonial governance and offers analytical leverage for understanding persistent fragmentation across the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了非洲区域一体化中"正式框架扩张但功能整合有限"的悖论，提出了"三墙框架"（情感墙、经济墙、社会墙）来解释碎片化如何作为一种自我强化的制度均衡持续存在。
AI.research_question: 为什么非洲的区域一体化在正式框架不断扩展的情况下，在贸易、流动性和政策协调方面的功能整合仍然有限？
AI.motivation: 现有研究分散地分析了制度薄弱、主权约束或外部依赖等问题，但缺乏一个整合性框架来解释非洲一体化中形式与功能之间的持续差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论；比较政治经济学；"三墙框架"（情感墙——排他性公民身份制度；经济墙——经济不安全与市场碎片化；社会墙——政治激励）。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，基于区域一体化和比较政治经济学的理论整合，提出分析框架。
AI.findings: 碎片化不是制度弱点的简单结果，而是由身份制度、经济结构和政治权威相互作用形成的自我强化制度均衡；"三墙"通过社会、经济和政治领域的反馈效应维持了这一均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"三墙框架"作为理解非洲及全球南方持续碎片化的整合性分析工具；将非洲一体化置于全球政治经济动态中，对区域主义、比较政治经济学和后殖民治理研究做出了贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了区域一体化在政治和经济上可行的条件，揭示了主权、分配与权威之间的权衡，为政策制定者理解碎片化的深层结构性根源提供了分析框架。

title: Formalising the Skill Supply Chain: Human Capital Bottlenecks and Sustainable Manufacturing in Pakistan's Furniture Sector

detail.title: Formalising the Skill Supply Chain: Human Capital Bottlenecks and Sustainable Manufacturing in Pakistan's Furniture Sector
detail.abstract: Sustainable supply-chain management theory has now expanded enough to encompass the social dimensions of production, yet the social arm of the triple bottom line has received less architectural attention than the environmental. In skill-based product industries-where product quality depends on the tacit, embodied capability of artisans rather than on machinery or process specification-this asymmetry leaves a critical upstream resource ungoverned. This chapter argues that in such industries, the skilled artisan is not merely a labour input but an upstream capability supplier whose reliability, renewal and credibility are conditions of sustainable production. In the craft-production traditions of South Asia, this figure is the Karigar. Drawing on Pakistan's furniture sector as an empirical case, and on the Karigar Initiative-an emerging skill-formation intervention anchored in a large formal furniture manufacturer in Pakistan-the chapter develops the Credible Skill Supply Chain Framework: a seven-stage architecture through which tacit craft knowledge is signalled, recognised, translated, formed, certified, absorbed and governed for renewal. The framework extends Seuring and Müller's (2008) TBL-SSCM social dimension from a compliance register into an architectural one, and generates four mutually reinforcing sustainability outcomes: economic, social, environmental and institutional. The chapter argues that formalisation should not erase informal mastery but make it visible, teachable, certifiable and renewable. In skill-intensive product industries, the sustainability of the supply chain depends on the sustainability of the skill-formation system that feeds it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“可信技能供应链框架”，主张在技能密集型产业中，手工艺人（Karigar）是上游能力供应商，其技能的可见性、可传授性、可认证性和可再生性决定了供应链的可持续性。以巴基斯坦家具行业和Karigar Initiative为案例，将TBL-SSCM的社会维度从合规扩展为架构性维度，产生经济、社会、环境和制度四重可持续产出。
AI.research_question: 在技能密集型产业中，如何将上游手工艺人（Karigar）的隐性技能纳入可持续供应链管理的架构性治理，而非仅停留在合规层面？
AI.motivation: 三重底线的社会维度在可持续供应链管理理论中受到的架构性关注远少于环境维度，导致技能密集型产业中关键上游资源（工匠的隐性技能）缺乏有效治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可信技能供应链框架（Credible Skill Supply Chain Framework），延伸Seuring & Müller（2008）的TBL-SSCM社会维度；隐性知识/技能形成理论；三重底线理论。
AI.method: 单一案例研究：巴基斯坦家具产业及Karigar Initiative（基于一家大型正规家具制造商的技能形成干预项目）。
AI.findings: 提出了七阶段架构：信号传递→识别→翻译→形成→认证→吸收→治理与更新；该框架产生经济、社会、环境和制度四重可持续结果；正规化应使隐性技能变得可见、可教、可认证和可再生。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TBL-SSCM的社会维度从合规清单（compliance register）扩展为架构性维度（architectural register），填补了可持续供应链管理在技能密集型产业中的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技能密集型产业（如家具、手工艺）提供了将工匠隐性技能纳入供应链可持续治理的具体操作框架；揭示了正规化与隐性技能传承之间的平衡路径。

title: Structured Irrationality Corrective Shadow, Ego Defense, and the Capacity to Be Wrong
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Structured Irrationality Corrective Shadow, Ego Defense, and the Capacity to Be Wrong

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构性非理性"概念，扩展了"校正性阴影"理论。非理性不仅源于认知偏差或动机推理，更根植于某种受威胁的形式（如自我形象、共享故事、制度合法性、AI平滑连贯性）为自我保护而拒斥校正的结构性机制。校正能力是理性的隐性前提，理性成熟在于校正能够改变负担路径。
AI.research_question: 非理性的结构性根源是什么？理性为何无法接纳校正？校正能力的隐性前提是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统非理性解释（偏差、启发式捷径、动机推理等）侧重于认知或信息层面，忽视了非理性的结构性维度——某种形式为自我保护而系统性地拒斥校正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 校正性阴影理论（荣格心理学中的阴影、投射概念）；结构性非理性；自恋型组织；校正能力作为理性的隐性条件。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，跨域类比（个人/关系/制度/AI中介四种形式）。
AI.findings: 非理性的结构性重复模式：形式自我保护→矛盾出现→矛盾威胁连续性→校正负担被转移到他处。校正无法发生是因为更深层的稳定性缺失（面对错误时感到湮灭、羞辱、崩溃或合法性死亡）。固定价值（个人层面）和可承受修正的合法性（制度层面）是校正能力的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"结构性非理性"概念，将非理性从认知偏差扩展至结构防御；深化校正性阴影理论；揭示校正能力作为理性的隐性前提；将自恋型组织视为负担转移的极端案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解个人、关系、制度和AI系统层面的非理性提供分析框架；为设计能够接纳校正的制度与AI系统提供方向性指导。

title: The Fire and the Train: Discourse, Power, and Decision in the Lahore Orange Line Metro Project

detail.title: The Fire and the Train: Discourse, Power, and Decision in the Lahore Orange Line Metro Project
detail.abstract: On the morning of 13 January 2017, Uzair Shah, General Manager (Operations) at the Punjab Mass Transit Authority (PMA) and Project Manager of Lahore's Orange Line Metro Train (OLMT), is summoned to the Chief Minister's Secretariat. The summons follows the death of seven workers two nights earlier in a fire at a makeshift residence operated by a subcontractor of Habib Construction Services (HCS), the civil works contractor for Package 1 of Pakistan's first rail-based mass transit project. The fire is the latest event in an eighteen-month cascade that has already produced a Lahore High Court (LHC) stay-order on construction near eleven heritage sites, the termination of the Package 2 contractor (Maqbool-Colson JV) and its successful counter-litigation, the displacement of more than 200 families along the route, a pending Supreme Court appeal, ongoing protests from the Lahore Bachao Tehreek (LBT) and its civil society coalition, and growing financial penalties under the China Exim Bank loan agreement. Shah's decision what to recommend at the 9 a.m. meeting-is no longer only technical. By January 2017, the OLMT has become a contested narrative space, with at least five distinct discourses authored by different stakeholders, each making a different claim about what the project is and for whom. This case is built to take students through that narrative-led reality of Pakistan's first transport megaproject in real time, and to give them analytical tools to act.

AI.tldr: 本文通过巴基斯坦拉合尔橙线地铁项目（OLMT）的危机案例，展示了大型交通基建项目如何成为多方利益相关者争夺话语权的叙事空间，要求管理者在技术决策之外进行叙事分析。
AI.research_question: 在大型交通基建项目中，不同利益相关者如何构建竞争性叙事？项目管理者应如何在多重叙事冲突中做出决策？
AI.motivation: 传统项目管理视角过度聚焦技术层面，忽视了大型基建项目在复杂社会政治环境中被不同利益相关者"叙事化"的现实。巴基斯坦首个轨道交通项目因文化遗产保护、合同纠纷、社会搬迁、诉讼等多重事件叠加，成为分析这一现象的典型情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事分析理论（Narrative Analysis）；利益相关者理论（Stakeholder Theory）；大型项目治理（Megaproject Governance）；话语权（Discourse）与公共政策的关系。
AI.method: 教学案例研究（Teaching Case Study），基于真实事件的实时情境构建，通过多方利益相关者的话语分析呈现竞争性叙事格局。
AI.findings: OLMT项目在18个月内至少产生了五种不同利益相关者话语：政府（发展现代化叙事）、法院（法治与遗产保护叙事）、承包商（合同权益叙事）、受影响市民（社会正义与生存权叙事）、公民社会（问责与透明度叙事）。项目管理者无法仅凭技术参数做出决策，必须理解并斡旋于这些竞争性叙事之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将叙事分析引入大型项目管理研究，提出"竞争性叙事空间"概念，拓展了传统利益相关者理论的分析维度，强调话语建构在实践中对项目命运的决定性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型基建项目管理者提供叙事分析框架和决策工具，提醒在项目启动前识别并管理关键利益相关者的叙事冲突，对巴基斯坦及其他发展中国家的大型交通项目具有直接借鉴意义。

title: Unequal Adoption of AI Writing in Scientific Publishing

detail.title: Unequal Adoption of AI Writing in Scientific Publishing
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether the diffusion of AI-assisted writing could become a new source of inequality in scientific publishing after the release of ChatGPT. I construct an article-level dataset of 130,879 research articles from 91 Elsevier journals, linking detector-based AI-writing scores from article introductions to author-background measures and publication-timeline data. Detected AI-writing signals rose sharply after ChatGPT but diffused unevenly, with larger increases among papers associated with male, non-OECD, and non-English-predominant author backgrounds. In the short run, however, this uneven diffusion did not translate into clear changes in published-author representation by gender, OECD status, or English-language background. Publication-timeline results are stage-specific: higher detected AI-use scores are associated with longer pre-acceptance review, especially from receipt to revision, while descriptive patterns suggest shorter post-acceptance stages. Journal-level difference-in-differences estimates, however, do not indicate systematic timeline effects. If current adoption patterns persist, AI-assisted writing may reduce language- and geography-based barriers while amplifying gender inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ChatGPT发布后，AI辅助写作在科研出版中的扩散是否可能成为新的不平等来源。通过构建13万篇Elsevier期刊论文数据集，发现AI写作信号在ChatGPT后急剧上升，且在不平等地扩散——男性、非OECD和非英语母语背景的作者增长更快。但短期内这种不均匀扩散并未显著改变已发表作者的构成。若当前模式持续，AI辅助写作可能减少语言和地理障碍，但会加剧性别不平等。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT发布后，AI辅助写作在学术出版中的扩散是否会成为新的不平等来源？
AI.motivation: AI辅助写作工具（如ChatGPT）的快速普及可能对科学出版产生深远影响，但其在不同作者群体间的扩散是否公平、是否会影响出版结果的不平等，是一个亟待回答的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散不平等理论、科学出版中的性别/地域/语言不平等理论
AI.method: 构建包含130,879篇研究论文（来自91种Elsevier期刊）的文章层面数据集，利用AI检测工具对论文引言进行AI写作评分，并将评分与作者背景特征（性别、OECD国家、英语国家）及发表时间线数据关联。采用描述性统计、回归分析和双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）进行估计。
AI.findings: （1）ChatGPT后AI写作信号急剧上升，但扩散不均匀：男性、非OECD、非英语母语背景作者增长更快；（2）短期内这种不均匀扩散未明显改变已发表作者构成的代表性（性别、OECD、英语背景）；（3）AI使用评分与审稿周期（尤其是从收稿到修改）呈正相关，但期刊层面的双重差分估计未发现系统性的时间线效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI辅助写作扩散的不平等模式及其对科学出版中既有不平等结构的潜在影响，拓展了技术扩散与学术不平等交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、期刊编辑和学术界提供了关于AI写作工具使用可能加剧或缓解某些不平等（如性别不平等vs.语言/地理障碍）的实证证据，有助于制定更公平的AI使用规范和出版政策。

title: The Invisible Green Building: Exploring the Gap Between Environmental Certification and User Recognition

detail.title: The Invisible Green Building: Exploring the Gap Between Environmental Certification and User Recognition

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support for this study was provided by the Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS) Faculty Initiative Fund (FIF) for the project 'Pro-Environmental Behaviour in Closed University Communities'.

detail.abstract: While environmental certification frameworks like LEED have become dominant global benchmarks for sustainable construction, a persistent gap remains regarding internal occupant engagement. This paper investigates this misalignment by analyzing a pioneering green-certified industrial facility in Pakistan's export-driven textile sector. The study uncovers a distinct empirical paradox: despite demonstrating exceptionally high pro-environmental worldviews, the building's everyday occupants possessed negligible awareness of its formal eco-certified status. Utilizing a mixed-methods research design, the study evaluates quantitative data from occupant surveys using the New Ecological Paradigm (NEP) scale alongside deep qualitative interview insights. The findings indicate that because the organization prioritized securing strategic outward legitimacy with international supply chain buyers, the technical standard failed to socially embed itself within the lived practices of workplace users. By moving institutional decoupling theory down to the micro-level, the paper conceptualizes this phenomenon as "certification without connection" and constructs the Certification-User Recognition (CUR) Framework. This two-by-two matrix maps out four unique variations of user-level decoupling, extending macro-organizational debates on institutional legitimacy while providing built-environment practitioners with a practical diagnostic tool to align technical design benchmarks with meaningful human experience.

AI.tldr: 本研究以巴基斯坦某绿色认证工业设施为例，揭示了绿色建筑认证（如LEED）在组织层面追求外部合法性时，忽视了内部使用者对认证的认知与参与，形成了"有认证无连接"的脱耦现象。作者提出认证-用户认知（CUR）框架，将制度脱耦理论下沉至微观用户层面，识别出四种用户层面的脱耦类型。
AI.research_question: 为什么绿色建筑认证标准在获得外部合法性的同时，却未能有效嵌入到建筑使用者的日常认知与实践中？
AI.motivation: 现有环境认证框架（如LEED）已成为可持续建筑的全球基准，但组织内部使用者的参与和认知仍存在明显缺口，这一"认证-用户认知鸿沟"尚未得到充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度脱耦理论（Institutional Decoupling Theory）、新生态范式（New Ecological Paradigm, NEP）、合法性理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：定量层面使用NEP量表对建筑使用者进行问卷调查；定性层面进行深度访谈。
AI.findings: 研究发现一个实证悖论：尽管使用者表现出极高的亲环境世界观，但对建筑本身的绿色认证状态几乎毫无认知。原因是组织优先服务于国际供应链买家的外部合法性需求，导致技术标准未能内化为使用者的社会嵌入实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度脱耦理论从宏观组织层面下沉至微观用户层面，提出"认证无连接"（certification without connection）概念，构建了认证-用户认知（CUR）框架，识别出四种用户层面的脱耦变体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑环境从业者提供了一个实用诊断工具（CUR框架），帮助将技术设计基准与有意义的人类体验对齐，弥合认证与使用者认知之间的鸿沟。

title: Extending the "Principle of Effective Demand"-Did Keynes Produce an Ad Hoc Tautology?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Extending the "Principle of Effective Demand"-Did Keynes Produce an Ad Hoc Tautology?
detail.abstract: Keynes extended his Principle of Effective Demand (PED), which explains how effective demand determines employment, to cover changes in effective demand and, inter alia, their price and output effects. However, owing to Keynes's poor presentation and Friedman's critique, the latter extension failed to gain traction, thwarting a fuller realization of the PED's potential as a fundamental macroeconomic principle. According to Friedman, Keynes's equation is a tautology, and ad hoc in its application. The paper demonstrates that Keynes obtained his equation in the form he did not because he was manipulating identities, but because his theory drew on the PED which requires that employment and output be substantively determined as functions of effective demand in wage units. His equation is therefore neither tautology nor ad hoc. It represents a genuine extension of the applicability of Keynes's Principle of Effective Demand, and opens a potentially useful line of enquiry in macroeconomics.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了凯恩斯有效需求原理的扩展并非如弗里德曼所批评的那样是恒等式或特设性假设，而是基于有效需求原理的实质性理论延伸，并指出了这一扩展在宏观经济学中的潜在价值。
AI.research_question: 凯恩斯有效需求原理的扩展是否如弗里德曼所批评的那样是恒等式（tautology）和特设性（ad hoc）的？
AI.motivation: 凯恩斯对其有效需求原理的扩展（涵盖有效需求变化及其价格与产出效应）因弗里德曼的批评而未获学界认可，阻碍了该原理作为基本宏观经济原则潜力的充分实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯的有效需求原理（Principle of Effective Demand, PED），要求就业和产出实质性地被决定为以工资单位衡量的有效需求的函数。
AI.method: 理论分析与逻辑论证，通过解析凯恩斯方程的理论基础，反驳弗里德曼的恒等式和特设性批评。
AI.findings: 凯恩斯的方程并非恒等式或特设性假设，而是有效需求原理的真实扩展；该方程为宏观经济学开辟了一条潜在有用的研究路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了凯恩斯有效需求原理扩展的理论实质，驳斥了弗里德曼的误解，恢复了该原理作为宏观经济基本分析工具的完整性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济学中关于有效需求变化与价格、产出效应的研究提供了新的理论切入点，有助于更全面地理解经济波动与政策传导机制。

title: From Herding Machines to Autonomous Agents: A Taxonomy of AI-Driven Flash Crash Mechanisms and the Regulatory Void

detail.title: From Herding Machines to Autonomous Agents: A Taxonomy of AI-Driven Flash Crash Mechanisms and the Regulatory Void

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping financial markets-accelerating execution, automating allocation, and concentrating analytical capacity within a shrinking set of foundational models. Prior work has documented AI's contribution to instability through algorithmic herding and highfrequency volatility, but the literature lacks a systematic classification of the mechanisms through which AI triggers catastrophic, self-reinforcing market dislocations, or "flash crashes." This prospective review proposes a three-category taxonomy: (1) endogenous algorithmic herding crashes, driven by correlated model behaviour; (2) exogenous model error cascade crashes, in which AI system failures propagate across interconnected venues; and (3) adversarial generative-AI disinformation crashes, in which fabricated narratives trigger automated trading responses. The taxonomy is grounded in the structural parallel between contemporary AI model homogeneity and the homogenization of Value-at-Risk (VaR) models before the 2008 crisis-a link recently formalized by Meng and Chen (2026). The analysis is extended to the emerging frontier of agentic AI-autonomous systems capable of multi-step planning and inter-agent interaction-which introduces qualitatively new systemic risks that existing regulatory frameworks are unprepared to 1 AI-Driven Flash Crash Mechanisms and the Regulatory Void address. The October 2025 cryptocurrency liquidation cascade, which liquidated over $19 billion within 24 hours, serves as the primary empirical case study. The article concludes with policy recommendations on model-diversity mandates, real-time AI trading surveillance, and adaptive circuit-breaker design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI引发金融"闪崩"的三类机制分类法：内生算法羊群崩溃、外生模型误差级联崩溃、对抗性生成式AI虚假信息崩溃，并以2025年10月加密货币清算级联为案例，提出监管建议。
AI.research_question: AI通过哪些机制引发灾难性的、自我强化的市场错位（即"闪崩"）？如何对这些机制进行系统分类？
AI.motivation: 已有文献记录了AI通过算法羊群行为和高频波动加剧市场不稳定，但缺乏对AI触发闪崩机制的系统分类。当前AI模型同质化与2008年危机前VaR模型同质化存在结构平行，亟需理论框架和监管应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）算法羊群行为理论；（2）模型误差级联理论；（3）生成式AI虚假信息传播理论；（4）模型同质化与系统性风险的结构平行（Meng & Chen, 2026）；（5）代理型AI（Agentic AI）的系统性风险理论。
AI.method: 前瞻性综述（Prospective Review），结合理论分类构建与实证案例分析（2025年10月加密货币清算级联事件）。
AI.findings: （1）识别出三类AI闪崩机制：内生算法羊群崩溃、外生模型误差级联崩溃、对抗性生成式AI虚假信息崩溃；（2）代理型AI引入全新的系统性风险，现有监管框架缺乏准备；（3）2025年10月加密货币市场24小时内清算超190亿美元，验证了级联风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出AI触发闪崩的三分类法，并将当代AI模型同质化与2008年VaR模型同质化建立结构平行，拓展了对AI系统性风险的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项政策建议：模型多样性强制要求、实时AI交易监控、自适应熔断机制设计，为金融监管机构应对AI引发的系统性风险提供操作指引。

title: Supply and Demand for Money in Pre-Industrial Societies

detail.title: Supply and Demand for Money in Pre-Industrial Societies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The author gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Sven Svensson Foundation for Numismatics, the Gunnar Ekstrand Foundation, and the Sven and Dagmar Salén Foundation.

detail.abstract:
In pre-industrial societies, the supply and demand for money were closely tied to the availability of commodity money, typically silver coins. This chapter develops a theoretical framework for monetary systems without central banks. On the supply side, coin output depended on the availability of precious metals and the institutional organization of minting. Under free minting, private agents could bring bullion to the mint and receive coins, which they distributed through market transactions. Because bullion could also be melted from coins, this system created a self-regulating mechanism adjusting the money supply through minting and melting. By contrast, under government-controlled minting the state monopolized coin production and introduced coins into circulation mainly through public expenditures, especially military wages and administrative salaries. This system allowed greater fiscal control but also carried a risk of over- or under-issuance.

On the demand side, labour specialization, comparative advantage, and expanding trade increased the need for money as a medium of exchange, while precautionary and speculative motives reflected risk and wealth storage in economies with weak insurance and financial systems. Monetary taxation and wage payments required a minimum level of labour division and functioning local markets, since households needed to obtain coins through exchange before they could pay taxes in coin. Once this threshold was reached, monetary taxation and wage payments reinforced monetization by increasing coin circulation and market integration. The chapter concludes by introducing the equation of exchange as a framework linking money supply, velocity, output, and prices in pre-industrial economies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个无中央银行体系下的前工业化社会货币理论框架，分析了铸币供给（自由铸币与政府控制铸币两种机制）和货币需求（交易、预防和投机动机）的决定因素，并讨论了货币税收与工资支付对货币化的强化作用，最后引入交换方程作为分析工具。
AI.research_question: 在前工业化社会（无中央银行体系下），货币供给与需求如何决定？不同铸币制度（自由铸币 vs. 政府控制铸币）如何影响货币供应和宏观经济运行？
AI.motivation: 前工业化社会的货币体系与现代中央银行体系有根本不同，但现有理论多聚焦于现代货币体系。理解历史上货币体系的内在运作机制，有助于丰富货币理论的历史维度，并为研究没有中央银行的货币体系提供分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 铸币供给理论：贵金属可得性与铸币制度；2. 自由铸币制度的自我调节机制（铸币与熔币）；3. 政府控制铸币的财政主导逻辑；4. 货币需求理论（交易动机、预防动机、投机动机）；5. 货币税收与工资支付的货币化条件；6. 交换方程（MV=PY）作为分析框架。
AI.method: 理论分析（概念框架构建），基于历史制度分析的理论演绎。
AI.findings: 1. 自由铸币制度存在自发的铸币-熔币调节机制，使货币供给具有自我均衡特征；2. 政府控制铸币有利于财政控制，但可能引发过度或不足发行；3. 货币化存在"门槛效应"：需达到最低劳动分工和市场交易水平后，货币税收和工资支付才能正向促进货币化进程。
AI.theory_contributions: 为前工业化社会、无中央银行的货币体系提供了系统的理论分析框架，填补了货币理论在历史维度上的空白，将交换方程（货币数量论）应用于历史经济分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解历史上货币制度对财政、贸易和价格水平的影响机制；为研究当代尚无健全中央银行体系的经济体的货币运行提供历史参照；揭示了货币化进程的制度前提条件。

title: The Gravity of OECD-Bound Migration, 1960-2020: Uncovering Contemporary and Deep-Rooted Determinants
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Gravity of OECD-Bound Migration, 1960-2020: Uncovering Contemporary and Deep-Rooted Determinants
detail.abstract: This study examines the determinants of migration from non-OECD origins to OECD destinations from 1960 to 2020 using a structural gravity framework. We first argue for a more comprehensive approach to migration dynamics than typically found in the literature. Utilizing Shapley dominance decomposition across a wide range of contemporary and historical drivers, we find that migration networks, historical ties, development, natural disasters, and conflict make comparable contributions and must be considered jointly. Second, we document shifting effects among origin-specific drivers. Natural disaster exposure is negatively associated with migration in 1960-1990-reflecting immobility under binding constraints-but becomes positively associated in 1990-2020. Conflict intensity remains a consistent positive driver. Economic development follows the "migration-hump" pattern in the earlier period, though this relationship weakens and shifts over time. Third, we demonstrate the significant role of dyadic determinants, introducing a novel ancestry-based connectedness measure derived from the World Migration Matrix. This indicator captures the persistent effects of deep-rooted demographic and cultural ties and exhibits robust explanatory power even after controlling for geographic distance, cultural proximity, and traditional historical linkages.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用结构引力模型，系统分析了1960-2020年间从非OECD国家向OECD国家迁移的决定因素，发现迁移网络、历史联系、发展水平、自然灾害和冲突等因素共同作用，且引入了基于世界迁移矩阵的祖先联系新指标。
AI.research_question: 1960-2020年间，从非OECD起源国向OECD目的国迁移的关键决定因素是什么？这些因素的影响如何随时间演变？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对迁移驱动因素的分析较为单一，缺乏对多种因素（经济、社会、环境、冲突等）的系统性综合考量，且忽略了这些因素随时间变化的动态效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity Framework）；移民网络理论；迁移驼峰理论（Migration Hump）；Shapley主导分解方法。
AI.method: 采用结构引力模型，运用Shapley主导分解方法，对1960-2020年间多个时间段的当代和历史迁移驱动因素进行贡献度分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）迁移网络、历史联系、发展水平、自然灾害和冲突等因素贡献相当，需联合考虑；（2）自然灾害在1960-1990年与迁移负相关（约束性不流动），1990-2020年转为正相关；冲突始终是正向驱动因素；经济发展在早期呈现"迁移驼峰"模式，但随时间弱化；（3）基于祖先联系的新指标（来自世界迁移矩阵）对迁移具有显著且稳健的解释力，独立于地理距离、文化距离和历史联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了更全面的迁移动力综合框架，引入了基于祖先联系的新测量指标，揭示了不同历史时期迁移驱动因素的动态演变规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定者提供了多因素联合考量的实证依据，特别是对自然灾害、冲突和经济发展等驱动因素的时期效应差异的理解，有助于制定更具针对性的移民管理政策。

title: Auto-Deleveraging and the Solvency-Fragility Tradeoff in Perpetual Futures Markets

detail.title: Auto-Deleveraging and the Solvency-Fragility Tradeoff in Perpetual Futures Markets
detail.abstract: Perpetual-futures exchanges guarantee solvency via auto-deleveraging (ADL), confiscating winners' gains once the fund is exhausted. We show this last-resort backstop is itself a source of fragility. Because it taxes the winning side rather than pre-committed capital, the arbitrageurs who absorb a liquidation cascade are also its loss-mutualization buffer, and they rationally flee it. A global game yields a unique threshold equilibrium, a position run by the would-be insurers. Solvency is thus bought with fragility: the run can deplete the confiscatable buffer and break the solvency it promises, while added arbitrage capacity raises run risk even as deeper markets lower it.

AI.tldr: 永续合约交易所的自动去杠杆化（ADL）机制作为最后担保手段，本身也是脆弱的根源。它通过没收赢家收益来维持偿付能力，但套利者（预期到会被征税）会理性逃离，导致“头寸挤兑”，反而可能耗尽保证金缓冲，破坏其承诺的偿付能力。
AI.research_question: 永续合约交易所的自动去杠杆化（ADL）机制如何成为系统性脆弱性的来源？
AI.motivation: 揭示ADL机制在保护交易所偿付能力的同时，因其对赢家征税的特性，反而可能诱发套利者的理性逃离和挤兑，形成内生的脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全局博弈（Global Game）：用于分析在ADL机制下套利者在不确定环境中的策略互动，推导出唯一的阈值均衡（头寸挤兑点）。
AI.method: 理论模型（全局博弈）：构建一个包含套利者策略选择、清算级联和ADL征收的博弈模型，求解唯一的阈值均衡。
AI.findings: 1. ADL机制将套利者同时置于“清算吸收者”和“损失共担缓冲”的双重角色，导致其理性逃离。2. 存在唯一的阈值均衡——“头寸挤兑”，即套利者会集体在某个临界点撤离。3. 偿付能力以脆弱性为代价：挤兑可能耗尽可没收的缓冲，破坏偿付能力。4. 增加套利能力可能提高挤兑风险（但更深的市场会降低风险），存在权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1. 首次从机制设计角度揭示永续合约ADL的内生脆弱性，补充了衍生品市场稳定性理论。2. 将全局博弈应用于加密资产衍生品市场的挤兑分析，拓展了“影子银行挤兑”理论的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1. 为永续合约交易所的风险管理设计提供警示，提示ADL作为最后手段的不稳定性。2. 为监管机构和市场参与者评估加密衍生品系统性风险提供分析框架。

title: Climate Stress and International Migration from MENA
affiliations: ,  and Migration Policy Group

detail.title: Climate Stress and International Migration from MENA
detail.abstract:
Existing research on the drivers of international migration is constrained by incomplete
measurement of volumes, directions and country coverage. Most studies focus on recent
decades, a narrow set of OECD destinations or a single flow type, even though categories
are blurred, new destinations have emerged and many developing countries now host large
migrant populations. Recent work suggests that migration drivers are best understood within
a broader migration system rather than in isolation. However, even in this newer literature,
long-run historical ties, such as deep ancestry links or very old migrant stocks, are still
rarely analyzed jointly with contemporary drivers and environmental pressures in a unified
empirical framework.
In this paper, we focus on MENA countries and use bilateral flow estimates from Abel
(2018) in a gravity framework to analyse how environmental stress interacts with the broader
social, political, and historical structures that organise migration. We distinguish fast-onset
shocks, measured by the number of people affected by floods and storms, from slow-onset
anomalies, captured by 12-month SPEI indicators for unusually dry and unusually wet conditions.
These origin-year shocks have been analyzed in a rich context of civil conflict,
development, urbanization, and agrarian exposure, and we further augmented the study
with historical migrant stocks around 1960 and a new ancestry stock measure we developed,
reflects historical ties built up in the Colonial Era. This study is one of the first to
incorporate deep ancestry-based ties into an empirical analysis of migration from MENA.
Our results show that fast-onset disasters affect emigration from MENA in a non-linear
way: small and moderate events are largely absorbed locally, while very severe shocks lead to
sharp increases in cross-border outflows. Deviations from normal moisture in either direction,
whether drought or excess rainfall, are also associated with higher emigration. In addition,
migrant stocks and ancestry links are strong and robust predictors of where migrants move,
even after we control for other conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用重力模型分析了MENA地区环境压力（快发灾害与慢发气候异常）如何与历史联系（移民存量、殖民时期祖先联系）共同影响国际移民流动。发现快发灾害呈非线性影响（仅严重灾害大幅增加移民），水分异常（干旱或过湿）均促进移民，且历史移民存量和祖先联系是流向的强预测因子。
AI.research_question: 环境压力（快发灾害与慢发气候异常）如何与更广泛的社会、政治和历史结构（尤其是长期历史联系）共同影响MENA地区的国际移民流动？
AI.motivation: 现有移民驱动因素研究受限于对移民总量、方向和国别覆盖的不完整测量，且很少将长期历史联系（如深层祖先联系或旧移民存量）与环境压力等当代驱动因素纳入统一实证框架进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移系统理论（migration system theory）、重力模型（gravity framework）
AI.method: 使用Abel (2018)的双边移民流估计数据，采用重力模型框架，结合快发灾害（洪水、风暴受影响人数）、慢发气候异常（12个月SPEI指数），并加入1960年历史移民存量和新构建的殖民时期祖先联系存量变量，对MENA国家进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 快发灾害对MENA地区移民呈非线性影响：小规模和中等灾害大多被本地吸收，而严重灾害导致跨境流出急剧增加。2. 水分偏离正常状态（无论干旱还是过湿）都与更高的移民率相关。3. 历史移民存量和祖先联系是移民流向的强且稳健的预测因子，即使在控制其他条件后依然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将深层祖先联系（殖民地时期建立的）纳入MENA地区移民的实证分析框架，拓展了迁移系统理论对长期历史维度与环境压力的整合理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解环境变化（特别是极端气候事件）如何驱动人口流动提供了非线性效应的经验证据，提示需关注严重灾害的跨越式影响；强调了历史纽带（移民网络和祖先联系）在预测移民流向中的关键作用，有助于制定更有针对性的移民管理与人道主义援助策略。

title: Downward Reclassification and University Enrollment: Evidence from the University of Idaho

detail.title: Downward Reclassification and University Enrollment: Evidence from the University of Idaho
detail.abstract: We examine the enrollment consequences of the University of Idaho's 2018 voluntary reclassification from the Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) to the Football Championship Subdivision (FCS). The Vandals became the first school to make the drop since the NCAA split the top division in 1978. Using a synthetic control method with a donor pool of non-Power Five FBS institutions, we find no statistically significant negative effect on total enrollment. Idaho's enrollment trajectory closely tracked its synthetic counterfactual through 2021 and outperformed it in 2022-2024. These results suggest that the enrollment costs of downward reclassification may be overstated, complementing recent evidence that the enrollment benefits of upward reclassification are similarly uncertain.

AI.tldr: 本文利用合成控制法研究了爱达荷大学2018年从FBS自愿降至FCS的招生影响，发现降级并未对总招生人数产生统计上显著的负面影响，甚至2022-2024年招生表现优于合成反事实学校。
AI.research_question: 大学体育项目从FBS降级至FCS是否会对总招生人数产生负面影响？
AI.motivation: 爱达荷大学是1978年NCAA拆分顶级联赛后首所自愿降级的学校，这为验证体育赛事等级变动对招生影响提供了自然实验机会。此前研究多关注升级的招生收益，而降级的成本尚不明确且可能被高估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体育赛事分级与大学招生的关系理论，涉及学校知名度的衰减效应、学生身份认同以及体育赛事对学校吸引力的边际影响。
AI.method: 采用合成控制法（Synthetic Control Method），以非Power Five的FBS院校作为潜在对照组，构建爱达荷大学的合成反事实，比较实际招生轨迹与反事实轨迹的差异。
AI.findings: 降级后爱达荷大学的总招生轨迹在2021年前与其合成反事实高度吻合，2022-2024年甚至优于反事实表现，未发现统计上显著的负面招生效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了体育赛事等级降级对大学招生影响的研究空白，表明降级的招生成本可能被高估，与近期关于升级招生收益不确定性的证据相呼应，完善了体育赛事等级变动与招生关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学管理层在体育项目等级决策（特别是降级选择）上提供了实证依据，表明降级可能不会如预期般损害招生，有助于消除对降级招生的过度担忧。

title: The Local Fiscal and Economic Effects of Population Aging
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service

detail.title: The Local Fiscal and Economic Effects of Population Aging
detail.abstract: Advanced economies, including the United States, are undergoing a sustained demographic transition toward older populations, driven by declining fertility and increasing longevity. While existing research examines the macroeconomic implications of population aging and the fiscal impacts for higher level governments, less is known about how population aging affects local fiscal and economic outcomes. Using a demographic shift-share design that exploits pre-existing variation in age structures, this paper analyzes the causal impact of changes in the elderly population share on county-level economic and fiscal outcomes between 2010-2022, a period that spans the retirement of the Baby Boom generation. Consistent with increased consumption demand from retirees, the results show that the aging of the Baby Boomers had little effect on local economic output or the size of government, but led to higher house prices and population growth, suggesting that local demand-side effects offset reductions in labor supply. These effects were heterogeneous, with an increased elderly share generating measurable economic gains in urban areas.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2022年美国县级数据，研究人口老龄化（尤其是婴儿潮一代退休）对地方经济和财政的影响。研究发现老龄化并未显著影响地方经济产出或政府规模，但推高了房价并促进了人口增长，需求侧效应抵消了劳动力供给减少的影响，且城市地区效应更明显。
AI.research_question: 人口老龄化如何影响美国县级层面的经济与财政结果？
AI.motivation: 已有文献主要关注人口老龄化的宏观经济影响及对中央/州级政府的财政冲击，但对地方政府（县级）层面的影响知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口转变理论、需求侧效应（退休人员消费需求增加）与供给侧效应（劳动力供给减少）的权衡框架。
AI.method: 采用人口结构偏移-份额设计（demographic shift-share design），利用2010-2022年间各县预先存在的年龄结构差异来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）老龄化对地方经济产出和政府规模影响甚微；（2）老龄化导致房价上涨和人口增长；（3）城市地区的老龄化效应更为显著，带来可衡量的经济收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人口老龄化在地方层面通过需求侧渠道（而非供给侧渠道）发挥作用的机制，丰富了老龄化经济效应的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府应对人口老龄化（尤其是婴儿潮一代退休潮）提供了政策启示，表明需求侧效应可能缓解劳动力萎缩的负面影响。

title: Commercial Financing Disclosure Laws and Nonbank Lending: Who Benefits and Who Suffers?
affiliations: University of Basel - Faculty of Business and Economics and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Commercial Financing Disclosure Laws and Nonbank Lending: Who Benefits and Who Suffers?
detail.abstract: Commercial Financing Disclosure Laws (CFDL) are state-level regulations that require nonbank lenders to provide transparent disclosures to small businesses when granting them credit. This study documents that nonbank lenders decrease interest rates and increase loan amounts for borrowers following the enactment of CFDL. The effects are more pronounced for marginal borrowers, such as startups and franchise entrepreneurs. Yet small business loans exempt from CFDL mandates experience a higher cost of credit and a reduction in lending volume. Those loans are also more likely to default. Overall, this study suggests that, while CFDL helps curb potential predatory practices by forcing transparency in small business lending, nonbank lenders pass on compliance costs on to less-regulated entities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国州级《商业融资披露法》（CFDL）对非银行放贷机构小企业贷款行为的影响，发现CFDL降低了受监管贷款的利率并增加了贷款金额，但对豁免贷款则导致成本上升、数量减少和违约率增加。
AI.research_question: 州级《商业融资披露法》（CFDL）如何影响非银行放贷机构对小企业的贷款定价、贷款规模及信用风险？
AI.motivation: 非银行放贷机构在小企业信贷市场中扮演重要角色，但其信息披露不透明可能导致掠夺性放贷行为。CFDL作为旨在增加透明度的监管法规，其实际效果尚待实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管合规成本传递理论；信息不对称与透明度监管；掠夺性放贷与消费者保护理论。
AI.method: 实证研究，利用州级CFDL实施为自然实验，比较受监管贷款与豁免贷款在法规实施前后的变化。
AI.findings: CFDL实施后：(1) 受监管贷款利率下降、贷款金额增加；(2) 对初创企业和特许经营者等边缘借款人的影响更显著；(3) 豁免CFDL的贷款成本上升、数量减少；(4) 豁免贷款违约率更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了透明度监管在遏制掠夺性放贷方面的有效性，同时发现了监管合规成本向非监管领域传导的"溢出效应"，丰富了金融监管经济后果的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计小企业信贷监管提供了实证依据，提示监管需关注合规成本可能被转移至豁免领域，从而产生监管套利与风险转移问题。

reference: Submitted for editorial peer-review to Revista Facultad de Ciencias Económicas de la Universidad de Guayaquil.
title: The Schooling Premium and Life-cycle Earnings in Ecuador: Empirical Evidence from the 2025 ENEMDU
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Schooling Premium and Life-cycle Earnings in Ecuador: Empirical Evidence from the 2025 ENEMDU

publicationDetails.detailsText: Submitted for editorial peer-review to Revista Facultad de Ciencias Económicas de la Universidad de Guayaquil.

detail.abstract: This study presents an updated empirical estimate of the private return on education in Ecuador, based on data from the 2025 National Survey on Employment, Unemployment and Underemployment (ENEMDU). Adopting the theoretical framework of human capital developed by Mincer (1974), an ordinary least squares (OLS) econometric model was used to analyze the impact of education and work experience on individual incomes. The research is based on a random representative sample of 999 observations, with a logarithmic transformation applied to monthly labor income to correct heteroscedasticity and ensure model stability. Empirical results reveal a robust and statistically significant correlation between education level and income level (p < 0.01). Our results indicate that the marginal return of an additional year of schooling is approximately 6.5%, all other things being equal. Furthermore, the inclusion of a quadratic experience term produces a negative coefficient (β =-0.00038), confirming the existence of a concave age-income profile in the Ecuadorian labor market. These data suggest that experiences' marginal utility decreases over the life cycle despite this increasing productivity. The model explains 14.9% of the variance in wages (= 0.1487), thus providing an essential benchmark for assessing the effectiveness of 𝑅² human capital investments in the current socioeconomic context of Ecuador.

AI.tldr: 基于2025年厄瓜多尔ENEMDU调查数据，采用明瑟收入方程，通过OLS回归估计出教育回报率约为6.5%，并验证了年龄-收入曲线的凹形特征。
AI.research_question: 厄瓜多尔教育投资的私人回报率是多少？教育和工作经验如何影响个人收入？
AI.motivation: 在厄瓜多尔当前社会经济背景下，需要更新教育回报率的实证估计，以评估人力资本投资的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 明瑟（Mincer, 1974）人力资本理论框架。
AI.method: 基于999个随机代表性样本，采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）计量经济模型，对月劳动收入进行对数变换以校正异方差性。
AI.findings: （1）教育水平与收入水平呈显著正相关（p<0.01），每多一年教育边际回报约6.5%；（2）经验二次项系数为负（β=-0.00038），确认了厄瓜多尔劳动力市场存在凹形年龄-收入曲线，即经验的边际收益随生命周期递减；（3）模型解释工资方差的14.9%（R²=0.1487）。
AI.theory_contributions: 在厄瓜多尔情境下验证了明瑟收入方程的有效性，并确认了经验回报递减的凹形收入曲线假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为厄瓜多尔教育政策制定和人力资本投资决策提供了最新的基准实证依据，教育回报率6.5%可作为评估投资效率的参考指标。

title: Stress Testing Tail Risk in India: A Comparative Evaluation of EVT-Copula and Gaussian Models

detail.title: Stress Testing Tail Risk in India: A Comparative Evaluation of EVT-Copula and Gaussian Models
detail.abstract: Standard Gaussian Value-at-Risk (VaR) frameworks systematically underestimate tail risk in financial markets characterised by fat tails and leptokurtosis. This paper develops and validates a GARCH(1,1)-Extreme Value Theory (EVT)-Student-t Copula framework for three Indian asset classes, Nifty 50 (equities), Gold (INR), and USD/INR (currency),using 18 years of daily data spanning September 2007 to December 2025. Marginal tail distributions are modelled via Peaks-Over-Threshold Generalised Pareto Distribution (POF-GPD) fitted to GARCH-filtered residuals, while cross-asset dependence is captured using a Student-t copula estimated by maximum likelihood. The resulting EVT-Copula VaR and Expected Shortfall (ES) estimates are benchmarked against their Gaussian counterparts across three portfolio allocations, and the models are backtested against realised 2026 returns. Across all asset classes, the EVT-Copula framework produces VaR estimates that are 5-20% higher than Gaussian VaR, and Expected Shortfall exceeding Normal VaR by about 60% across all portfolios. Backtesting against the realised breach events in January-April 2026 confirms that EVT-Copula ES bounds actual losses more tightly than Normal VaR on every occasion. These findings provide direct empirical evidence that Gaussian models materially understate downside risk in the Indian multi-asset context, and that EVT-based ES is a more reliable regulatory and portfolio risk metric.

AI.tldr: 本文使用18年印度市场数据，构建GARCH-EVT-Student-t Copula框架，发现其VaR估计比高斯模型高5-20%，ES超过高斯VaR约60%，回测证实EVT-Copula能更紧地约束实际损失，证明高斯模型严重低估印度多资产尾部风险。
AI.research_question: 在具有厚尾和尖峰特征的金融市场中，标准高斯VaR框架是否系统性地低估了尾部风险？EVT-Copula模型能否更准确地衡量印度多资产类别的下行风险？
AI.motivation: 传统高斯VaR模型在金融市场的厚尾特征下会系统性低估尾部风险，可能导致风险储备不足和监管失效。本文旨在为印度这一新兴市场的多资产组合提供更可靠的极值风险度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（EVT）、广义帕累托分布（GPD）、Student-t Copula、GARCH(1,1)模型、期望尾部损失（Expected Shortfall）
AI.method: 使用2007年9月至2025年12月的18年日度数据，涵盖Nifty 50（股票）、黄金（INR）和美元/印度卢比（货币）三类资产。对GARCH(1,1)过滤后的残差使用POT-GPD建模边际尾部分布，用最大似然法估计Student-t Copula捕捉跨资产依赖关系，并将EVT-Copula的VaR和ES与高斯模型进行对比，基于2026年实际回报进行回测。
AI.findings: EVT-Copula框架的VaR估计比高斯VaR高5-20%；ES超出高斯VaR约60%；2026年1-4月的回测显示EVT-Copula ES每次都比正态VaR更紧地约束实际损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场多资产场景提供了EVT-Copula框架相较于高斯模型更准确衡量尾部风险的直接实证证据，证明了基于EVT的ES是更可靠的监管和组合风险指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度市场投资者和监管机构提供了更准确的风险度量工具，有助于改进风险资本配置和监管框架，避免因高斯模型低估风险而导致的风险储备不足。

title: The Optimal Timing of Product Introduction and Safety Investments for Automated Vehicles
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Optimal Timing of Product Introduction and Safety Investments for Automated Vehicles

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: The emergence of autonomous vehicles (AVs) raises important questions regarding the interaction between liability regulation, technological development, and market adoption. While AVs have the potential to substantially improve road safety in the long run, their early deployment is likely to involve elevated accident risks and uncertainty regarding legal responsibility. This paper examines how alternative liability regimes affect a monopolistic producer’s incentives to invest in AV safety and its decision regarding market entry. Building on the dynamic model of Dawid et al. (2022), we develop an analytical framework that links liability allocation to intertemporal safety investments and market diffusion. We first analyze the benchmark case of certain producer liability and show that stricter producer liability may reduce safety investments when market demand is low, but can strengthen long-run investment incentives once demand reaches a sufficiently high level. Furthermore, delayed market entry is shown to reduce cumulative safety investments, increase accident probabilities, and lower producer profits. We then extend the model by introducing uncertainty about future liability regulation and demonstrate that the qualitative results remain robust under both open-loop and Markov investment strategies. From a welfare perspective, neither full producer nor full consumer liability is optimal. Instead, an intermediate liability regime that balances producer responsibility with the internalization of accident externalities generates the highest social welfare. The findings suggest that accelerating the deployment of autonomous vehicles, supported by appropriately designed liability rules, can improve both safety outcomes and technological progress, while regulatory uncertainty does not fundamentally alter these conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同责任制度如何影响垄断生产商在自动驾驶汽车安全投资和市场进入决策方面的激励，发现适度的中间责任制度能最大化社会福利，加速AV部署可同时改善安全结果和技术进步。
AI.research_question: 不同责任制度（生产者责任、消费者责任、中间责任）如何影响垄断生产商在自动驾驶汽车安全投资和市场化进入决策方面的激励？
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶汽车早期部署涉及较高的事故风险和法律责任不确定性，如何设计最优的责任制度以平衡安全投资激励、市场扩散速度和社会福利，是当前监管和产业实践面临的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dawid et al. (2022)的动态模型，构建了链接责任分配与跨期安全投资、市场扩散的分析框架，区分了开环策略和马尔可夫策略下的投资行为。
AI.method: 动态模型分析，包含基准情形（确定的生产者责任）和扩展情形（引入未来责任制度的不确定性），比较不同责任制度下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: (1) 当市场需求低时，更严格的生产者责任可能降低安全投资；市场需求高时则会增强长期投资激励。(2) 延迟市场进入会减少累积安全投资、增加事故概率并降低生产者利润。(3) 完全的生产者责任或完全消费者责任均非最优，中间责任制度产生最高社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将责任制度设计与动态安全投资、市场扩散决策纳入统一分析框架，揭示了责任严格程度与市场需求水平之间的非线性交互效应，并验证了结果在监管不确定性下的稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶汽车的责任制度设计提供了政策建议：不宜采取极端责任分配，应实施适度中间责任制度；加速AV部署可同时促进安全和技术进步；监管不确定性不会根本改变最优政策方向。

title: YouTube Influencers as Information Intermediaries
affiliations: , Brigham Young University - Marriott School, Brigham Young University and Texas A&M University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: YouTube Influencers as Information Intermediaries
detail.abstract: We examine the role of influencers who provide long-form video content on YouTube as information intermediaries in capital markets. Many investors increasingly rely on influencers to inform their trading decisions, but regulators have expressed concerns about the potential harmful effects of influencer content. We find that the videos of YouTube influencers are associated with increased market activity, particularly from retail investors, and that negative video content relates to net retail investor selling pressure around earnings announcements. Influencer coverage is also associated with increased efficiency in the pricing of earnings news. Finally, we provide evidence that a number of influencer and video attributes moderate their market effects. Overall, our findings offer a nuanced understanding of the important and growing role that YouTube influencers play in capital markets.

AI.tldr: 研究发现YouTube网红（长视频内容创作者）作为资本市场信息中介，其视频内容与市场活动增加、零售投资者交易行为以及盈利新闻定价效率提升相关，且网红和视频的多种属性会调节这些市场效应。
AI.research_question: YouTube网红作为信息中介在资本市场中扮演什么角色？他们的内容如何影响市场活动、投资者行为和信息效率？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的投资者依赖网红视频进行交易决策，但监管机构对其潜在危害表示担忧，因此需要对网红在资本市场中的实际影响进行系统性实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息中介理论、零售投资者行为理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 实证分析，利用YouTube网红长视频内容数据与资本市场数据进行关联分析，检验视频内容对市场活动、零售投资者交易行为及盈利新闻定价效率的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 网红视频与市场活动增加相关，尤其是零售投资者交易活动；(2) 负面视频内容与盈利公告期间零售投资者的净卖出压力相关；(3) 网红覆盖与盈利新闻定价效率提升相关；(4) 网红和视频的多种属性（如网红特征、视频内容特征）会调节上述市场效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将YouTube网红纳入资本市场信息中介的理论框架，拓展了对非传统信息中介（社交媒体内容创作者）在定价效率和投资者行为中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估网红内容对市场的影响提供实证依据；为投资者理解网红内容的信息价值提供参考；为平台和内容创作者提供内容治理的启示。

title: Review Essay: Tuuli Wohlström's Thesis 'Europe Beyond the Courts. Constitutionalism, Pluralism and Integration in the Nordic Countries'
affiliations: University of Kent, Law School

detail.title: Review Essay: Tuuli Wohlström's Thesis 'Europe Beyond the Courts. Constitutionalism, Pluralism and Integration in the Nordic Countries'

declarations.funderStatement: Tidskrift utgiven av Juridiska Föreningen i Finland (JFT) is published open access by the Law Society of Finland, using the Licence CC BY-NC (Attribution-NonCommercial). The journal has a tradition of publishing Opponent Statements of doctoral theses defended in Finland. Journal website https://journal.fi/jft/

keywords: The Nordic Social Welfare State model

publicationDetails.detailsText: Tidskrift utgiven av Juridiska Föreningen i Finland (Journal Published by the Law Society of Finland) (2025) Volume 161 Issue 5-6, pp. 390-430. Open access at https://journal.fi/jft/

detail.abstract: This review essay seeks to invite a wider consideration of Tuuli Wohlström's doctoral thesis 'Europe Beyond the Courts: Constitutionalism, Pluralism and Integration in the Nordic Countries'. Prompted by the observation that the Nordic countries have been overlooked in the EU legal pluralism discourses due to court-centric perspectives, Wohlström documents manifold conflicts with, and limits to, EU law, and argues that to understand these, it is necessary to expand the frame of reference to the broader constitutional cultures. Wohlström shows that in the Nordic countries, limits to EU law have predominantly been set by parliaments and through ex ante constitutional review mechanisms. However, she argues that EU law has brought about 'major shifts' in the institutional configurations, with a reluctant and vexed process of strengthening the power of courts. This culminated with the Ajos case of the Danish Supreme Court where, for the first time, a Nordic court said 'No' to the CJEU. The present reviewer adds broader comments from the point of view of comparative European constitutional law, and suggests that many Nordic constitutional values – especially the social welfare state – ought to be regarded as a model, rather than be replaced by neoliberalism and neofunctionalism through EU governance. The review also calls for a formal acknowledgement of structural problems in EU research, and puts forward a policy proposal to support the international publication of doctoral theses on national and comparative European constitutional law.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于Tuuli Wohlström博士论文的评述，该论文指出北欧国家在欧盟法律多元主义讨论中被忽视，原因是过于以法院为中心的视角。Wohlström展示了北欧国家主要通过议会和事前合宪审查来限制欧盟法，但欧盟法也推动了司法权强化，最终以丹麦最高法院在Ajos案中首次对欧盟法院说"不"达到高潮。评述者从比较欧洲宪法角度提出，北欧宪法价值（尤其是社会福利国家）应被视为模式而非被新自由主义取代，并呼吁正式承认欧盟研究中的结构性问题。
AI.research_question: 北欧国家如何在与欧盟法的互动中，通过宪法文化和制度安排来设定对欧盟法的限制？
AI.motivation: 北欧国家在欧盟法律多元主义讨论中被忽视，现有研究过于以法院为中心，未能充分捕捉北欧独特的宪法文化对欧盟法的回应方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟法律多元主义、比较宪法学、宪法文化理论
AI.method: 文献综述与比较宪法分析（结合对Wohlström博士论文的评述）
AI.findings: 1. 北欧国家限制欧盟法主要通过议会和事前合宪审查机制，而非司法事后审查；2. 欧盟法推动了北欧国家司法权强化的艰难转型；3. 丹麦最高法院在Ajos案中首次对欧洲法院说"不"；4. 北欧社会福利国家等宪法价值面临欧盟新自由主义和新功能主义的压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了欧盟法律多元主义的分析框架，将关注点从法院转向更广泛的宪法文化，弥补了北欧国家视角的缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁将北欧宪法价值（特别是社会福利国家）视为模式而非被取代；提出支持国家及比较欧洲宪法学博士论文国际出版的政策建议。

title: Measured, not Priced: Structural Identification of Discount-rate Sentiment

detail.title: Measured, not Priced: Structural Identification of Discount-rate Sentiment

declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Research Center of Athens University of Economics and Business under grant ``Enhancing the Educational and Research Activities of the Department of Accounting and Finance'' (ER-3093-01).

detail.abstract: Can a small, structurally restricted state-space system measure a sentiment state with a recognizable economic signature? We impose a behaviorally augmented dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) state-space model on a monthly panel of macroeconomic, valuation, sentiment, and anomaly observables, and identify a persistent discount-rate sentiment state through sign and exclusion restrictions disciplined by over-identification tests and by shrinkage-path and perturbation audits. The state tracks the Baker-Wurgler index (correlation 0.88) with the familiar sentiment chronology, and raises the cross-sectional R 2 of the Fama-French 25 portfolios from 0.10 to 0.31. Its price of risk is Shanken-significant but not robust to misspecification-aware inference; the stochastic discount factor is rejected; there is no tradable alpha; and a pre-registered duration prediction returns a null. The state is measured, not priced: the measurement discipline-which itself detected and removed a spurious duration result-is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为增强型DSGE状态空间模型，从宏观、估值、情绪和异常变量中识别出一个持久性的贴现率情绪状态，该状态虽能被精准测量（与Baker-Wurgler指数相关0.88，提高资产定价截面R²至0.31），但无法被定价（SDF被拒绝，无可交易alpha，预设检验不显著），说明贡献在于测量纪律本身而非情绪的风险价格。
AI.research_question: 一个结构受限的小型状态空间系统能否测量出具有可识别经济特征的情绪状态？该情绪状态是否被定价？
AI.motivation: 现有情绪指标（如Baker-Wurgler指数）缺乏结构约束，存在测量噪声；同时学界对情绪是否被定价存在争议。作者希望用结构化DSGE模型提供更严谨的测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为增强型DSGE状态空间模型；贴现率情绪理论；SDF定价框架；Shanken检验与错设稳健推断。
AI.method: 在月度面板数据（宏观、估值、情绪、异象因子）上施加行为增强型DSGE状态空间模型，通过符号约束和排除约束识别情绪状态，并用过度识别检验、收缩路径和扰动审计进行验证；再通过横截面定价检验（Fama-French 25组合）、SDF检验、可交易alpha检验和预先注册的久期预测检验评估情绪是否被定价。
AI.findings: (1) 识别出的情绪状态与Baker-Wurgler指数高度相关（0.88），时序吻合；(2) 加入情绪后，Fama-French 25组合截面R²从0.10提升至0.31；(3) 情绪的风险价格在Shanken检验下显著，但在错设稳健推断下不显著；(4) SDF被拒绝；(5) 无可交易alpha；(6) 预先注册的久期预测返回零结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出行为增强型DSGE状态空间模型作为情绪测量的结构化方法；揭示了"测量"与"定价"之间的根本区别——情绪可被精确测量，但未必具有稳健的定价能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界和实务界提供了一个更严谨的情绪测量框架；警示研究者不要仅依赖情绪的风险价格显著性来判断其经济重要性，需考虑错设稳健性；预先注册和扰动审计等做法增强了研究的可重复性和可信度。

title: Toward Human-Centered Sustainability. Emotional, Relational, and Cultural Utility in Economic Behavior: Insights from Thailand

detail.title: Toward Human-Centered Sustainability. Emotional, Relational, and Cultural Utility in Economic Behavior: Insights from Thailand
detail.abstract: Contemporary sustainability debates increasingly recognize that ecological crises cannot be understood solely through assumptions of rational utility maximization and growthcentered development. Drawing on insights from behavioral economics, well-being research, and sustainability studies, the paper develops a broader conception of utility that incorporates emotional, relational, and cultural dimensions of human welfare. It makes three contributions. First, it proposes emotional utility, relational utility, and cultural utility as complementary dimensions of human welfare that help explain why well-being depends upon psychological stability, social relationships, and culturally meaningful forms of life. Second, it introduces the concept of behavioral sustainability, defined as the long-term reproduction of sustainable patterns of behavior through supportive social, emotional, cultural, and institutional conditions. Third, it illustrates the relevance of this framework through the case of Thailand, where concepts such as sabai-sabai, kreng jai, nam jai, and the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy reflect culturally grounded understandings of well-being that go beyond material accumulation. The analysis suggests that sustainability should be evaluated not only according to ecological outcomes and economic performance but also according to its capacity to support trust, belonging, resilience, and enduring quality of life. Sustainable development therefore requires conceptions of welfare that account for what people need to live well, not only what they consume.

AI.tldr: 本文从行为经济学、幸福感研究和可持续发展研究中汲取洞见，提出了包含情感效用、关系效用和文化效用的更广泛的效用概念，并引入"行为可持续性"概念，通过泰国案例说明文化嵌入的幸福感理解对可持续发展的意义。
AI.research_question: 如何超越理性效用最大化和增长中心的发展假设，构建更全面的效用概念来解释人类福祉，并以此重新审视可持续发展的评价标准？
AI.motivation: 当代可持续发展讨论越来越认识到，仅凭理性效用最大化和增长中心的发展假设无法充分理解生态危机，需要更全面的福祉概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、幸福感研究、可持续发展研究；情感效用、关系效用、文化效用；行为可持续性概念
AI.method: 理论建构与案例研究（泰国案例，涉及sabai-sabai、kreng jai、nam jai、充足经济哲学等概念）
AI.findings: 可持续发展不仅应根据生态结果和经济绩效来评估，还应根据其支持信任、归属感、韧性和持久生活质量的能力来评估；可持续发展需要关注人们过好生活需要什么，而不仅仅是他们消费了什么。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出情感效用、关系效用和文化效用作为人类福祉的互补维度；引入"行为可持续性"概念，定义为通过支持性的社会、情感、文化和制度条件长期复制可持续行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过泰国案例展示了文化嵌入的幸福感概念（如sabai-sabai、kreng jai、nam jai和充足经济哲学）如何超越物质积累，为政策制定和实践提供文化敏感的可持续发展路径参考。

title: The Epistemic Filter Theory of Survey Inference

detail.title: The Epistemic Filter Theory of Survey Inference
detail.abstract: This paper develops the Epistemic Filter Theory of Survey Inference, a social-theoretical and methodological framework that connects projected stochasticity, random sampling, measurement design, and research validity. The paper introduces and begins from the non-play-dice paradigm, defined here as the claim that apparent stochasticity can arise when an observer, researcher, or model has access only to a projected subset of a more complex system. In statistical physics, the Mori-Zwanzig projection operator formalism expresses this logic by deriving reduced stochasticlooking dynamics from exact Liouvillian evolution. In social research, the analogous problem is methodological rather than ontological: researchers cannot observe the full social field and must instead rely on sampling frames, measurement instruments, analytic models, and validity diagnostics. The framework therefore treats random sampling, questionnaire measurement, weighting, factor analysis, and structural modeling as epistemic filters that determine what becomes visible, what remains outside the dataset, and how uncertainty enters inference. The paper formulates mathematical survey operators, defines a five-construct measurement model, proposes validity and reliability criteria, specifies factor and structural models, develops platform-based implementation scenarios, and provides full reproducible R scripts for simulation, validation, and Bayesian updating. Applications are developed for public opinion research, journalism studies, media literacy, digital trace research, influencer economies, misinformation research, platform governance, and hidden-population analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"调查推理的认知过滤理论"，将随机性视为研究者对复杂系统投影观察的结果（非掷骰子范式），并建立将随机抽样、问卷测量、权重调整、因子分析和结构建模视为认知过滤器的系统方法论框架，配套可复现的R脚本。
AI.research_question: 如何从社会理论与方法论层面，将调查推理中的随机性重新概念化为认知投影的产物，并建立统一的过滤理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统调查方法论对随机性的理解偏向本体论（将随机性视为现实固有属性），实际上面向社会复杂系统时，随机性源于研究者认知通道的有限性（即只能观察到系统的投影子集）。
